title: Elasticity

sections.heading: 1. Stress-Strain & Hooke's Law
sections.proseLatex: Stress $= F/A$, strain $= \Delta L/L$. Hooke's law: stress $\propto$ strain within elastic limit.

keyFormulas.label: Young's Modulus
keyFormulas.aiExplainContext: Ratio of stress to longitudinal strain.

sections.heading: 2. Moduli & Elastic Energy
sections.proseLatex: Young's $Y$, Bulk $K$, Rigidity $\eta$ moduli. Elastic potential energy $= \frac{1}{2}F\Delta L$.

keyFormulas.label: Elastic Energy
keyFormulas.aiExplainContext: Energy stored in a deformed body.

workedExamples.problemLatex: Two wires same dimensions, different materials. Compare Young's moduli from graph.

wbjeebTraps: Hooke's law applies only within the elastic limit.
